messages:
Priya S.: Hey — I accepted the GitHub invite but I still don't see the org or any repos. I get 'access denied' when visiting https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference. Anyone run into this? :thinking:
Sam T.: Hi Priya — welcome! Did you enable 2FA on your GitHub account? Org requires 2FA + SAML SSO. Check your email for the invite — there should also be a 'Grant SSO access' button when you try to access a private repo.
Priya S.: I enabled 2FA last night (TOTP). I clicked the invite link from my work email, but I'm using my personal GitHub username (priyaa). Could that be the problem?
OnboardBot: Welcome message: "hi priya — your GitHub invite was recorded. If you used a different GitHub account than the invite email, ask People Ops to resend or have an admin transfer the invite. See https://intranet.redwood/team-onboarding#github"
Sam T.: If your invite went to priya@redwood.com but you're signed in with priyaa@gmail.com, the invite won't attach. Two options: (1) sign out & sign in with the company email/username, (2) ask @Jules to re-invite the gmail address.
Priya S.: Ok — I realize I signed in with my personal one. Signing out now and switching accounts.
Zack (eng-platform): FYI platform team auto-add to teams is a separate step. Once you accept SSO you'll still need to be added to 'eng-runtime' and 'eng-platform' teams for repo access. Ping me here and I'll add you to 'serving-runtime' & infra repos.
Priya S.: Thanks! One quick Q: do I need to add SSH keys now? I prefer SSH, but we use HTTPS for some CI.
Sam T.: Yes please add an SSH key if you'll be pushing. Steps:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "priyaa@redwood.com"
eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub  # then paste into GitHub Settings -> SSH and GPG keys
ssh -T git@github.com
```
Zack (eng-platform): After you're visible to the org I can add team membership. If you still can't see the org after switching accounts, paste the output of `ssh -T` or a screenshot and I'll help troubleshoot.
Jules (People Ops): Re-invite sent to priyaa@gmail.com with note to use company account instead. Also added comment on the invite asking for the GitHub username to be used for mapping.
Priya S.: I switched accounts, clicked 'Grant access' for SSO, and I can see the org now. Thank you!! Can you add me to eng-runtime + eng-platform?
Zack (eng-platform): Done — you should have org-level membership and repo access. Try `gh repo clone redwood-inference/serving-runtime`.
Priya S.: Cloned fine. :tada: Thanks everyone — onboarding is smoothing out. 
Sam T.: Welcome aboard! Ping if anything else blocks your dev env.
